name: I
note: Attempt I: start from the pilot-v2 clone (84.8% real task) and train ONLY on the real task. Why: in H the real-task result fell from 83% (gen 0) to 58-61% by gen 25 in the 'boulder, calm air' stage, despite 40% rehearsal; the clone leans on the clean wind sensor, which reads ~0 in calm air, so those weights drift. Same lesson as B-D: with an expert start, any world but the real one erodes skill. 24 flights per network, re-fly top 8 on 60.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Hold the clone's ~85% and push the remaining failures (boulder hits, off-pad, crashes, ~4-5% each) down. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.
